newsitem.title: USA: Iridium loses contact with satellite.
newsitem.headline: Iridium loses contact with satellite.

text.p: Iridium LLC said on Friday that it was informed by Motorola Inc that it lost contact with an Iridium satellite.
The loss of the satellite was confirmed on July 17, 1997, Iridium said in a statement.

The satellite was one of five launched on July 9, 1997 and was awaiting its ascent to a final mission orbit, Iridium said. The other 16 satellites orbiting earth continue to function within normal parameters, the company said.
If the loss of the satellite is confirmed, Iridium said it will not bear the financial risk or loss, nor will it affect the scheduled date for commercial service in September 1998.
Representatives from Iridium and Motorola were not immediately available for further comment.
